necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of atrial fibrillation (I48.91), raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia recurrence. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), continuous monitoring via CPT 93229 is clinically indicated to detect potential embolic sources or rhythm disturbances that may have been missed on standard ECG.
